foodpics_image_no.Description: Image number in the Food-pics database (Blechert et al., 2014, https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2014.00617; numbering as in Food-pics_Extended, Blechert et al., 2019, https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2019.00307). The image files are not redistributed here; they are available from the Food-pics database.

foodpics_description.Description: Item description (English) as given in the Food-pics database.

category_in_task.Description: Category of the image in the categorization task (the true category used to score accuracy).

familiarity_omnivore_raters_pct.Description: Food-pics normative familiarity: percentage of omnivore raters who reported being familiar with the depicted food (dichotomous yes/no item), averaged over the male and female omnivore rater groups as given in the Food-pics_Extended database. Norms were collected outside Latin America and were not rated by the participants of this dataset.
